mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and increasing present value of future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed tightening that raises real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term coefficient in regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a further decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market overheating, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening supply conditions, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise above thresholds, or the interaction term coefficient in regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recoveries, a strong increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals accelerating economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during early-cycle recoveries when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
